work_title: Aura Admin Dashboard UI & API Implementation Plan
goal_summary: Implement a premium, responsive Dark Glassmorphic Admin Dashboard SPA with query parameter routing, integrate aggregate shop KPIs, and secure R2/D1 operations on backend.
preserved_behavior: WooCommerce-like order state transitions (Pending Payment -> Processing -> Completed), image file preview URL lifecycle safety, and local dev JWT authentication bypass are fully preserved.

slices.description: Implement GET /admin-api/metrics endpoint in Hono worker compiling total sales, total orders, refund rate, and low-stock count from D1. Wrap orders refund endpoint POST /admin-api/orders/:id/refund in D1 Transaction with Stripe refund handling.

Refactor apps/admin-ui App.css and index.css with Dark Glassmorphism CSS variables matching storefront styles. Implement search-param routing (?tab=overview|orders|products) in apps/admin-ui/src/App.tsx.
Rebuild App.tsx to introduce SidebarNavigation, StatsGrid, OrdersTable (with confirming Modal), and ProductForm (with R2 file drag/drop). Connect all components to backend REST endpoints.

impact_radius: D1 SQL performance: Ensure dashboard aggregates are index-based queries to avoid full-table scans.
Cloudflare R2 Payload limits: Enforce max 5MB on images, rejecting larger payloads in worker middleware.
Refund processing: Mitigate double-refund race conditions via idempotency checks in Stripe refund endpoint.

quality_gates.tests: Validate refund flow and metrics computations using local integration testing suites.
quality_gates.review: Inspect UI CSS Variable alignment and confirm image preview URL cleanup handles memory disposal correctly.
quality_gates.build: Run pnpm build in apps/admin-ui and wrangler build in apps/admin-api to verify bundle sizes (<1MB).
quality_gates.security: Enforce CORS lock and check Zero Trust middleware protection on all admin REST endpoints.

rollout_notes: Deploy apps/admin-api D1 updates first, verify metrics endpoints, then deploy apps/admin-ui client build to Cloudflare Pages.
rollback_notes: Revert the admin-ui deployment in Cloudflare Pages to the previous stable release hash. Local dev can rollback query-param routing to basic useState easily.
documentation_deltas: Instruct operators on configuring Stripe Secret Keys for local dev CLI testing.
Document local dev bypassing rules for Access JWT authentication in admin environments.
open_questions: Do we want charts (e.g. lightweight Canvas charts) for sales history, or are KPIs sufficient for the MVP?
Should we support CSV downloads of orders and products?
